v0_4_0.title: What's new in 0.4.0
items: No more 8 GiB root requirement: the driver is now prepared in the inactive SteamOS A/B system and activated by a reboot, the current system is kept as a fallback
New rollback button to go back to the previous system
Compiled builds no longer in use are cleaned up automatically, and builds from earlier versions are migrated
Redesigned driver picker with the source of each version shown on a second line
Notifications now use the NVIDIA icon

v0_3_0.title: What's new in 0.3.0
items: New Settings page: plugin self-update, bug report, feature request, support the development
Build a driver version Arch never packaged, straight from Arch's own packaging repos — see the new section under the version picker
